propositions: autodeploy recreates review-bot container without draining in-flight reviews, killing code review operations mid-process
during landing bursts with commit gaps shorter than review duration, successive container recreations interrupt retries, preventing convergence and live-locking the LLM-Review gate
killed reviews emit no VOTER_ERROR signal because process termination is not a voter failure, making the live-lock invisible to health monitoring and CloudWatch alarms
the reconciler's review_and_vote call runs outside the shutdown queue, so it is cancelled within 10s despite the bot's 1200s drain timeout, making the retry path unprotected
autodeploy now defers deployment if in_flight reviews are detected via /health endpoint, bounded to 1800s per deferral episode to prevent permanent blocking
deployment deferral is logged as AUTODEPLOY_DEFERRED and review interrupts are tracked with AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT alarm for observability of the previously-blind failure mode
